I am writing to you to invite you to reflect on the not-so-distant history of your institution. During the 1970s, the systematic practice of forcing left-handed students to write with their right hand was a rule enforced severely by the nuns at the school.

To this day, the psychological, learning, and forced laterality consequences of those senseless acts continue to linger for those who suffered them. What was then normalized as "education" was, in reality, a systematic violation of the natural development of minors.

This leads us to ask a crucial question in our times: Are the families of the children currently studying in your classrooms aware of what this school did to the minors under its care?
Modern education is based on transparency, respect, and the trust of families. That is why this testimony, along with the analysis of the lasting effects suffered by those affected, could be shared and disseminated on social media. We believe that the current educational community has every right to know the history of the place where their children's education is being implemented.

In 1973, their school SUSPENDED all subjects in the first year of primary school for left-handed students who, like me, refused to stop being LEFT-HANDED.

one_star_reviews.text:
The experience was quite unpleasant. It's a very aggressive sales tactic, and I feel like I've been scammed like never before, especially considering the underhanded way they handled the whole process. So, think things through very carefully before they trap you like they did me.

It all started with the "consultation"—three of us went to see the doctor about a "SPECIAL OFFER" on hyaluronic acid… and what a surprise! The offer was for "one vial," and you need another one for the other half of your face! 🤣 Yes, really! The offer is only for half your face. The "fine print" is that it's only for half the offer; the other half doesn't fit in the door. So, the price jumps from €200 to €400. Imagine the dumbfounded look on my face! I mean, €200 MORE for another vial because I need two, and this guy conveniently forgot to mention that two vials are needed for a full face treatment. In what world is an offer for half a face?! And of course, the Botox they were "offering" "isn't as strong for men," and naturally, what does that mean? Another €60 more.

Of course, he tells you this after you've signed all the paperwork and you're there to see who goes first... three people in the tiny room, under pressure to get it done right away, no time to react, no time to think—a classic setup. And when you leave there you're like, "But... what have I done?!" The whole thing ended up costing me almost €300 more. (€300 more for two people and €60 more for the third, €660 more because there was missing information in the offer)

And the kicker is that there's no "touch-up" after 15 days, it's a "revision," and what was the next "surprise"?! Two of us had to get a "touch-up" because we insisted, since their strategy was that none of the three of us needed any touch-up... and the final straw is that they used only ONE remaining vial (there were 3 of us and they used only 1 vial for the touch-up) and they touched up TWO of us!

I repeat! A single vial of touch-up was used for two people, and the doctor insisted to the third that they didn't need any touch-up, even when that person mentioned a slight difference in height between the two sides of their face.

I was astonished the first time I went; I couldn't react to the underhanded and aggressive sales tactics. But after the touch-up, I couldn't believe he could be so unprofessional, using such methods to deceive people, and using only one vial of touch-up for everyone.

I was shocked when I went. And yes, I made sure to check how many vials for touch-ups were on the table where he keeps the materials, and to see that there was ONLY ONE VIAL FOR TWO PEOPLE, I couldn't believe what I was seeing, and what I was doing...

So please, DON'T TRUST HIM, ask everything before doing anything, because this man is trying to squeeze money out of you at every turn. It's not normal to go in for €400 and leave having paid almost €700. ALMOST DOUBLE!

I strongly advise against booking a property through Marbs Vacation Agency.

I made the mistake of not researching the rental agency thoroughly enough and based my decision mainly on the many positive reviews of the apartment. Looking back, I would strongly recommend reading the negative reviews as well before booking.

During our entire stay, we had no hot water whatsoever. We contacted the agency through their WhatsApp service and were given several possible solutions, but none of them resolved the problem. When we specifically asked for someone to come to the property and fix the issue, our request was simply ignored.

As a result, we could not take a single hot shower during our entire stay.

We therefore submitted a complaint through Booking.com. Booking.com subsequently offered us a small compensation in the form of a voucher, which we felt was not proportionate to the inconvenience we experienced.

What happened next was even more concerning: we discovered that 50% of our rental amount had been withheld by the agency, despite the fact that we had left the apartment clean and in good condition and had not damaged anything.

This was a very disappointing experience. The lack of hot water throughout the entire stay was already unacceptable, but the lack of an adequate response and the subsequent withholding of 50% of the security deposit made the situation even worse.

Based on our experience, I would not book through Marbs Vacation Agency again and would strongly recommend that potential guests carefully research the agency itself, rather than relying solely on reviews of the property.

They're thieves. They responded quickly to my booking, but now they haven't replied.
I've been charged twice and haven't received a refund.

one_star_reviews.text: We had been several times before, and the service yesterday was appalling. My husband and I sat down at a table with our 16-month-old son around 8:40 pm and waited for the rest of our group. The waitress arrived and rudely asked if we wanted anything, to which we replied that we were waiting for the rest of the group. That's when her bad attitude, rudeness, and lack of manners began. We ordered three dishes; there were empty tables, and they took a long time. We even had to repeat one of them because she had forgotten. She brought the drinks incorrectly and said that we had told her to. The worst part was that we asked her to make a chicken fillet with potatoes for our 16-month-old son. After waiting for over an hour, we asked her again because all the adults had already finished their dishes, and his food still hadn't arrived. Again, she was rude and impolite, chewing gum in front of the customers, and said it was coming—obviously, she had forgotten. Not even an apology. We had also asked for a spoon, and he never brought it. The worst part came when I went into the restaurant to ask if the chicken fillet was cooked yet; it was 10:20 PM. Almost two hours after arriving, he tells me it was almost ready, again in a rude manner, with bad gestures and looks. I told him that if it wasn't ready, we would leave, that we had been waiting for almost two hours, that a baby's food is the first thing served, that we had asked him, and that we had only received rude responses from him. He told me that everything I was saying was false. We asked for a complaint form, and the owner told us that their printer was broken. We will go back this afternoon to ask for one; it's not legal not to have complaint forms. We have never, ever been treated like this. We will never return, and we will not recommend it to anyone. Unacceptable and intolerable.

My experience with this specialist (both in the private and public healthcare systems) has been utterly disheartening and has had very serious consequences for my mother's health.

My mother's pancreatic enzyme treatment was discontinued despite her having exocrine pancreatic insufficiency. The decision was made based solely on routine blood tests, without ordering follow-up tests or assessing her actual clinical progress. Following the discontinuation of treatment, my mother's condition deteriorated drastically, suffering intense pain for a year and requiring multiple visits to the emergency room (112).

Given her constant decline, we decided to consult with other gastroenterologists privately, including a head of the gastroenterology department. After reviewing the case, they confirmed that they did not understand why the enzymes had been discontinued or why continuous monitoring tests had not been scheduled for a condition like exocrine pancreatitis.

I believe there has been a severe lack of clinical judgment and insufficient monitoring of the patient's condition. I do not recommend their care if you are looking for a comprehensive assessment and adequate continuity of treatment.

one_star_reviews.text:
I'm giving it a 1 because I can't give it a 0. I arrived there with everything arranged. I was going to get the hair color you see in the WhatsApp screenshots. They told me there wouldn't be a problem, that it would take about two and a half hours because my hair was short and everything seemed fine. I asked for a green outline and a layer of black on top for €150, which I was willing to pay. I arrived, they sat me down without hardly saying anything (we were also communicating through a phone translator). I explained what I wanted and they didn't object. Suddenly, I found myself with the bleach on for about 10 minutes. I asked them to show me the green colors they had, and despite telling them I didn't want the one they'd shown me, they used it (I realized later when I saw the bottle). But they applied it after only 10 minutes of bleaching. It was on wet hair (a fantasy dye) and they didn't even let it sit for 10 minutes under the sink. She put me back in the chair, and I saw my blue hair—horrible, with different shades in each section—and I thought she was going to apply another dye so it would take properly. Suddenly, she started drying and styling it, and I was speechless. I asked, "What about the black? And this color that has nothing to do with what I asked for?" She said there wasn't enough time, that I should come back tomorrow for the black (without ever asking if I was available, and that she couldn't or didn't want to do everything at once). She said my hair was very damaged, which is why the dye wasn't taking. Honestly, it was a disgrace. She started swearing in her language (which I understand a little, and swearing is one of those things) when I told her she should have warned me from the beginning if she saw that my hair was going to turn out badly and that I couldn't go out in public like that. In the fourth photo, you can see me walking out the door (I'm not posting any more because I'm embarrassed), and in the fifth, you can see how I managed to style it myself at home in less than two hours, even though I'm not a professional. It was a disgrace. They offered me a second appointment, but I wouldn't set foot in that place again. Don't go.

one_star_reviews.text:
We made our way by car on a 300km + trip towards our destination (2€ per liter), for our two night reservation of this quaint rural property. We were arriving a little late for a 16:00 entry so we put in contact, out of courtesy, with the host, Maria, who’s number was given to us by our “agent”, Sergio Cecilio Merino, to inform her of our latent ETA. After informing Maria, the host, of our arrival time, Maria claimed she knew nothing of the reserve at all (!!, even though she received the payment 7 days prior) and that the property was already occupied by 4 persons, entering the night before, and leaving a day after our exit date, she “couldn’t do anything about it”. We were absolutely flabbergasted, we then tried putting in contact with Sergio, our “agent”,  but surprisingly his phone (landline) was out of range/ non existent 🧐. We decided to go to the dirección provided (by the 3rd party website) anyways to see what was going on for ourselves, in person.

We arrived to the property, which perfectly matched the photo description and address (provided by Halidu/ RVBO/ Expedia) , to find the same number on the mail box matching that of the host, Maria. We rang the doorbell, it didn’t work, we knocked on the door, no one answered, so we decided to round into the backyard for signs of life. By happenstance we encountered a lady, in pijamas, resting in the enclosed property of the house. We politely explained the situation, but she claimed she couldn’t produce her reservation as “her husband/ boyfriend had it” she was left alone (by all 3 of the others..?) .  My friend noticed an oddity, she had the same voice and  mannerisms/ expressions, as Maria, our contact on the ground, on the phone, number on the mailbox, we left suspicious. We had no choice but to head to the closest Guardia Civil/ authorities, since there was zero mobile phone coverage, to sort the situation en sitio, we had to travel various kilometers to get a few bars of coverage for the internet. The Guardia Civil confirmed our reservation but recommended us to confirm the location even though it was obvious that there was no competition in a village of ten houses…. We returned making the half hour route again, and confirmed that there was ZERO error.

It was late, almost getting dark and we were forced to make our way back home to spend our rare, weeklong, hard fought, coordinated and organized vacations back. 3 hours of driving by night, after all the subsequent kerfuffle, kms back and forth, hands to the head, and endless effort,…our conclusion

It’s a fraud, they stole our hard earned, blood, sweat and tears money. They provided ZERO attention and blew us off. They provided no assistance, and instead of solving a possible administrative problem, they revealed their fraud, they threw us in the trash and have our money.

If you want to have a respectable host for a much needed, hard earned vacations, avoid this bottomless pit like the plague, they have ZERO shame.

We expect 100% of our payment to be refunded, this will not stand still, and we will take legal action.

Regards

An incredible lack of professionalism and seriousness.
I dropped off a shirt yesterday and was told I could pick it up today after 12:00. They were also very insistent that I not be late because they "closed at 2:00 PM." We made a point of being there before that time, and when we arrived to pick it up, they calmly told us the shirt wasn't there and that we'd have to come back in the afternoon.
So why are they so insistent on the schedule with the customer if they themselves can't meet the deadline they've given?
We wasted our time and had to travel for absolutely nothing due to a lack of organization that isn't their responsibility. If an item isn't going to be ready at the agreed time, the least they can do is notify the customer before making them go there. Very little professionalism, terrible organization, and customer service that leaves much to be desired. I certainly won't be back.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with this clinic was quite negative.
I called to schedule a specific procedure, but they ended up scheduling another one. After the procedure, about 15 days later, I contacted them because I was still in pain and another small bump had appeared. The advice I received was that "it was normal" and that I should continue applying the ointment for another 5 days.
When I completed 1 month and contacted them again, I informed them that the situation remained the same. The response was that I could only have another application after 2 months.
At 45 days, I contacted them again and was informed that I should wait until the 2 months were up. In addition, the clinic was going to close for vacation and, when it returned, I could then schedule an appointment.

In short, I was very dissatisfied with the service from beginning to end. I found the procedure expensive and felt a lack of follow-up and care after it was performed. Given the situation, I decided not to return for the second session and to look for another clinic where I had a completely different service experience.
I'm sharing this account because I believe it's important for others to know about my experience before choosing a clinic.

A couple of months ago, a relative went to this law firm because they claim to be experts in several areas of law. They resolved absolutely nothing; the service lasted no more than 5-10 minutes, culminating in the following response: “I believe we could proceed in X way regarding your inquiry.”

I understand that no one always knows absolutely everything, and as professionals, doubts may arise or we may not be 100% certain… but in these situations, professionalism is essential, and that professionalism translates into agreeing to consult with a colleague and providing a concrete and definitive answer afterward, even if payment is made upfront… not washing their hands of the matter with “I’m not sure” and still billing.

I am responding to your firm's comment regarding a review I posted years ago, which you attempted to remove/challenge on Google, as you have done with so many others. However, when I appealed, Google ruled in my favor, leaving you no choice but to respond now. The consultation my relative made was simply a request for legal advice; it didn't require anything more: it wasn't a lawsuit, nor any other matter that requires opening a file and working on it for as long as necessary, so no quote was given, only a "no advice" because they didn't know what to do in a given situation.

one_star_reviews.text:
“WE CALL PEOPLE WHO ARE DIFFERENT THE WEIRDOS”

It's important to note that this review is written in my own name, as the experience of the other 40 people was different.

In my case, the way I was treated was unacceptable. Having several food intolerances due to health reasons, I made sure to call the owner well in advance so they could adjust the menu for me (€40, which for everyone else included three starters, a main course, and dessert…). We agreed on two starters and one main course. I arrived, they brought out my starter, and everything seemed fine, but then I saw them continuing to serve everyone else while leaving me there with nothing. After a while, I went and spoke to the waiter, who told me that the owner had said we had only agreed on a starter and a main course, which I denied. They called her and said, “It's written down if you want to see it.” We looked at it, and it confirmed what I had said (two starters). They apologized and said they'd made a mistake and that they'd lower the price of the meal (I was starving, by the way) and that they couldn't offer me anything else (then they asked if I wanted meat).

But that's not the worst part… one of the waiters said to me, “Hey, look, I'm going to tell you something that might sound harsh, but don't take it the wrong way because we talk like this to understand each other… we call you guys THE WEIRDOS… and that way we know who we're talking about…” Seriously, you say that to one of your customers? Honestly, if you think or say things like that (which I still find despicable, you think it but don't say it, because it's completely unnecessary).

My meal was ruined by the comment directed at me, especially since I have a medical condition, and on top of that, there's what I've already mentioned.

My family seemed happy with the catering, but honestly, this is my review.

one_star_reviews.text:
And why can't I give it a zero? I don't understand how they can rent out a holiday home in such a state... It's completely reflected in the first comment and the photos. The chalet was filthy, it was disgusting. The first day we arrived we had to clean, because we weren't going to live there in that filth. A wasted day and a ton of work... We had to wash all the dishes, tablecloths, bathrooms, EVERYTHING, and the smell of dampness permeated the entire chalet... Oh, and clumps of dog hair everywhere, even on the bedspreads and sofas.

I've noticed that most of the comments are from two years ago. I don't know what to think about the good ones. Maybe they were lucky and they only clean at the beginning of the season, or maybe they're fake reviews... We warned them the first day that the sink was overflowing, and they did nothing. We put a clay pot down to catch the water and prevent it from falling into the cabinet (which we should have left as is...) and it filled up in no time, and the smell of rottenness was awful! Already quite fed up with everything, we told them we wanted them to call a plumber, that this was unacceptable, and nobody ever showed up... After the fortune we paid, the only good thing about it was the pool, that's it!

I don't know who to blame for this, but the only people we had contact with were Paola and Claudia. What I do know is that if I pay for something, I expect it to be in decent condition to live in for that week. In the end, we spent more time at the villa because my parents are elderly and we go to the beach less often. We were there from August 16th to 23rd, 2026.
Of course, we will never return and we do not recommend it.
With a thorough cleaning and a few minor repairs, it would have been great, but it wasn't...

one_star_reviews.text: Some people have very little self-worth. This guy Jose, who manages Las Casas del Lago in Ribadelago, charges €190, which is the daily rate for a Type I house in August 2026. That's his value, and I think that's a lot. He kept the deposit after guaranteeing me a refund if I canceled in advance, especially considering I was booking five months ahead. I made the transfer on March 13th to reserve from August 8th to 14th. I called on July 6th to cancel, and he told me he wouldn't refund my money, that's what reservations are for. Draw your own conclusions.

We gave a month's notice to cancel the reservation, and they refused to refund our deposit.

When we made the reservation months in advance, they assured us there would be no problem with cancellations.

We initially spoke with Aaron to cancel the reservation for medical reasons, and he said there was no problem. The following week, his brother-in-law and business partner refused to return our deposit.

After speaking with Aaron, who said he would resolve the issue with his brother-in-law, we still haven't heard anything. To this day, we still haven't received our deposit back.

They haven't been ringing these bells for very long; it wasn't like this before. And I say they're unnecessary. There are other people, especially elderly people, who are also bothered by them, and the neighbors across the street, where there are many elderly and sick people, are also bothered by them.

one_star_reviews.text:
Everything was great until we returned the van. This was several years ago, but I've only just gotten around to writing this review.

The van was delivered to us in acceptable condition, but it wasn't spotless. We took a week-long trip, and on the last day, we cleaned it quite thoroughly and returned it. I'd say it was even better than when we received it. It could have been delivered to another customer in that condition.

The next day, they called us saying the van was filthy and that we had to clean it. Obviously, this whole story is quite subjective, and I'm not going to upload the videos, but to give you an idea, two of the things they said were unacceptable were that the wheels had the typical black brake residue (the kind that doesn't come off unless you scrub for a while, and which was also how it was delivered to us). Another UNACCEPTABLE thing was that the windshield had bugs on it (we sprayed it on the outside with a pressure washer, but we all know windshields don't get spotless unless you scrape them a bit). We returned the van very clean, but obviously it's their responsibility to finish it for the next customer, especially since they demanded things from us that we hadn't received.

These are just two examples. The person in charge at the time wouldn't even bother to watch the videos we took when we picked up the caravan and wouldn't budge. They made us clean things that were already dirty when we received them, and we had to do it because they had our deposit. Furthermore, their attitude was quite unprofessional.

I don't know how things are now. This was 3 or 4 years ago. Just in case, make videos of everything as soon as you receive it.

--

To the owner's response:

- Yes, I'm posting this review now because I saw it by chance, and at the time, when it happened, you were just starting out and didn't have it.

- Yes, it's true that it was delivered late and we weren't penalized. It's also true that we notified them and, very politely, they told us there was no problem. Later, however, they throw it in our faces.

- No, I'm not saying it had mosquitoes, I'm saying it had residue that the air gun doesn't remove, similar to what appeared in the video WHEN WE PICKED IT UP. In the attached video, you can't see it on the windshield, but you can on the front grille. So you don't call me a liar.

- The service wasn't as they claim, not by a long shot. And yes, the service and the completely disproportionate level of cleanliness (I repeat, it was cleaner than when we picked it up) negate everything else and deserve a 2-star rating, or even 1 star.

- All the attached photos and videos are from the time of pickup, and in fact, we accepted it as satisfactory. The problem is that we returned it in better condition, and even then, he tried to give us a hard time. In a normal situation, I would never have considered that the van was returned to me in poor condition. I'm only posting the photos because he asked us for things that they themselves didn't fulfill.

For everyone else, just make a video when you pick it up and when you deliver it.

one_star_reviews.text:
Here's my review. I left my 2016 BMW 116d, which I'd bought three months prior and had just been painted. The car is always garaged and very well maintained. I decided to take it to this car wash, and to my surprise, I found that the bumper had been scratched. The owner came out with a bottle of solvent and tried to cover it up as best he could, but the product had already eaten away at the clear coat and paint.

Furthermore, after a while, I noticed some yellowish stains appearing on another area of ​​the car that had always been spotless and where I'd never had any problems before. After consulting with the car wash technician about the cause of these defects, he indicated that it was due to poor waxing technique or the use of a very abrasive product that had damaged the bodywork, turning it yellow.

The owner initially told me he would fix the scratch but that "they hadn't done anything," begging me not to leave a bad review (practically trying to bribe me). However, when I also mentioned the yellow stains, he sent me a four-minute audio message at the end of the next business day washing his hands of the matter and threatening to sue me if they hadn't fixed it.

I'm not about to waste my time on this, and I don't like being called a liar, much less anything like that. I've just filed a formal complaint with the Consumer Information Office (OMIC) in the municipality. I hope the qualified officials will review it, and that anyone else with the same problem—and judging by the reviews, I know I'm not the first—please do the same. This guy can't keep lying to our faces, and we can't have people who don't take good care of our cars.
Services
Auto detailing, Auto interior vacuuming

one_star_reviews.text:
An expensive waste of time.
I booked online & by phone (with the assistance of my Spanish speaking wife to eliminate any language misunderstandings) a full service for my Kove 450 Rally specifically requesting that valve clearances where checked & adjusted if required. I arrived early at 08:30 on the appointed day as instructed. The mechanic had not been advised of the scope of work in advance & appeared surprised and unhappy that he was expected to do a major service (all fluids, spark plug & valves). He stated that the bike needed to be cold for the valves & I replied that I could wait as long as was necessary. Then the mechanic said that he wanted to go home early due to the holidays. We agreed to review when he reached the spark plug. However, without further discussion at 12:30 I was presented with a fully assembled bike - when I asked about the valves I was told they hadn't been done! The mechanic appeared to be getting ready to go home at this time.
I was then presented with a bill for €327- for 3 hours labour & parts.
I am not impressed by this poor customer service. Why book a bike in for work if it can't be completed. The bike could have been delivered earlier if required, but I was told to arrive at 09:00 on the day of the service appointment. Kove 450s are very easy to work on, you can get to the spark plug in 15 minutes, so how a simple spark plug & fluids service could take 3 hours (bike has ABS bypassed, so it is simple to bleed the brakes) I do not understand.
When I queried the extortionate labour time I was firstly told it was because there was fuel in the tanks (half full). When I suggested this was a nonsense reason, the second explanation given was that it took 2 mechanics to refit the front tanks so the labour charge was double! I have singlehandedly removed the Kove tanks with ease, so the claimed requirement for 2 professional mechanics to do the job is ridiculous.
One of the original rear tank upper mounting bolts was replaced with an odd assortment of nuts/bolts/washers during the service - strangely no mention of fitting non-standard parts was made by the mechanic at the time.
I tried to buy a spare oil filter, but only a €92- full service kit was available!
Based on my experience I don't recommend this Kove service centre - the customer's requirements appear to come second to the mechanics personnel agenda, and the pricing/time taken is excessive. The only reason I wanted to do the minor service items was that it made sense while the bike was fully dissembled for the valve checks.
A very expensive bad experience - my worst in 40 years of motorcycling.

one_star_reviews.text:
COMPLAINT FOR HUMILIATING TREATMENT, LACK OF RESPECT, AND POTENTIAL DISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT

I wish to file a formal complaint regarding the treatment I received from a store employee.

On [DATE], I went to the store intending to purchase a sheet/pillowcase, using my own money. When I went to pick up the item, an employee told me I couldn't because, according to her, it was prohibited to take it at that time.

I initially complied with her instruction. However, I then saw two other customers taking items from the same location. Therefore, I asked why they could take them and I couldn't. The employee explained that they had authorization from the store manager.

Given this explanation, I asked her to call the manager so I could speak with her directly and verify if such authorization actually existed and if I could also obtain it. My intention at all times was to clarify the situation and respect the store's rules.

However, the employee started arguing with me and told me that if I didn't shut up, she would call security to have me removed from the store. She did call security, and two security personnel arrived.

I felt deeply humiliated and ashamed in front of other people, as if I were trying to steal, when I had simply gone to the store to buy the product and pay for it with my own money.

Furthermore, the employee literally said to me, "I always have problems with Moroccans." I consider this comment very serious, offensive, and discriminatory, as it directly refers to my origin.

Later, my daughter approached the checkout to calmly ask the cashier if we could actually take that product or not. At that moment, the employee quickly went to the register and told the cashier that if we arrived with that case, she shouldn't charge us for it.

This situation made me feel even more singled out and humiliated, especially since I had previously seen other customers take products from the same place.

I want to make it clear that at no point did I attempt to steal or take any product without paying. I wanted to buy it and was prepared to pay. All I asked for was an explanation and, if necessary, authorization from the manager, just as the other customers supposedly had.

This entire situation affected me greatly emotionally and triggered an anxiety attack.

Therefore, I request that Alcampo management:

1. Conduct a thorough investigation of everything that happened.

2. Review the actions of the employee and the intervention of the security personnel.

3. Review the security camera footage and, if possible, identify the employees and customers present at the time.

4. Clarify the exact policy regarding that product and why other customers were allowed to take it.

5. Investigate specifically the comment: "I always have problems with Moroccans."

6. I request a formal apology from the employee for the treatment I received and for the humiliating situation I endured in front of other people. 7. I request a written response to this complaint and to be informed of the measures taken.

I believe that, as a customer, I have the right to be treated with respect, regardless of my background, and to receive a clear explanation of the store's rules.

Sincerely,

When I needed bodywork and paint repairs, I decided to take my car to Mercedes. I trusted the prestige of this car brand and, consequently, the bodywork specialists. I believed they would have a good repair method.

(The price of labor and materials they use gives an indication of the quality of the repairs.)

-What did I find after a while?
I took it in for two accidents on different dates.

-For the first accident, they only had the front bumper painted. I've attached a photo of what they did...

-For the second accident, they had the side painted, which will probably chip just like the front bumper. They left two clips broken from the roof trim and the door seal torn. They said the seal was broken before I even took it there. Luckily, I was able to prove it, and I saved myself €60, if not more, which is what the entire door seal costs.

-The second accident was for painting the side panel. On the other hand, when they painted the side, they got paint on both rims and tires because they didn't cover the area properly, and paint also got inside the car. I had to pay for a car wash to clean the entire interior! It took me a while to remove all the paint that got inside because they didn't properly close and seal the vehicle with tape and plastic before painting.

This is where you can see the difference in a job well done.

one_star_reviews.text:
I had an appointment with a doctor at this gynecology clinic, and my experience with the administration has been terrible.

It's practically impossible to contact them by phone. After being on hold for 7 to 10 minutes, the answering machine asks you to leave a voicemail with your name and phone number so they can call you back. I left about 4 or 5 messages asking them to call me back, and they never returned a single call.

Furthermore, they seem to schedule appointments far too tightly. It gives the impression that the clinic is trying to see as many patients as possible, even though each consultation costs around 150 euros, and as a result, patients have to wait an extremely long time. On my first visit, I waited an hour.

For my second appointment, I decided to book online to save time. Before my appointment, I called the clinic to ask how the doctor would contact me and gave them my name and the time of my appointment. They told me they would remind the doctor.

It's been two hours since my scheduled appointment and no one has called me. I've tried calling the clinic four times and they're not answering the phone either.

The organization and administrative support are truly appalling.

one_star_reviews.text:
I'm giving it one star just to give it something.
UNACCEPTABLE. DO NOT BUY HERE.

A complete disgrace and utter chaos. The saleswomen themselves tell you that some days it reaches up to 40°C inside the store, a totally unacceptable situation for both employees and customers, and that they've even had to close because of it.

To make matters worse, I placed an order that was supposed to arrive in 2-5 days and I've been waiting for OVER A MONTH. I try calling Ulanka's customer service number and NO ONE EVER ANSWERS. Even the saleswoman called in front of me and they still couldn't get through.

And the worst part is that, after looking for reviews and opinions, I see that I'm not the only one this is happening to. There are many people with similar problems, orders that don't arrive, lack of customer service, and unresolved complaints. The most outrageous thing is that no one seems to be offering a solution.

What is this? It's all a complete mess. Orders don't arrive when promised, they don't answer the phone, and there doesn't seem to be any solution for customers.

I certainly won't be buying from here again, and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. If you have a problem, you seem to be completely on your own. A terrible experience.

They're not professionals; they don't know what products they're selling. I emphasized several times that I wanted genuine leather shoes. They told me there were only three models. I bought a pair, and to my surprise, they were made of what they now call "vegan leather"—just plain old faux leather or synthetic leather—and they weren't cheap. I don't recommend it, and I won't be going back. Of course, I always check everything before leaving the store.

Almost without looking at me, they sent me to another colleague, and I asked about Korean creams. It turned out they were the ones talking. When older people get wrinkles, they can get Botox." I couldn't believe what I was hearing. On top of that, the cream was for someone young! What a lack of professionalism, and all because I interrupted her! An unacceptable lack of professionalism and manners towards a customer. I certainly don't plan to return, and I don't recommend anyone go to a place where you're treated like that.

one_star_reviews.text:
An absolutely dreadful experience. It's hard to find a pharmacy that gives such a bad impression from the very first moment.
The establishment seemed neglected, and the overall image leaves much to be desired. There are pharmacies in the area that seem to belong to a completely different category, with a much wider variety of products, better presentation, and far more professional service.

And then there's the treatment I received from Cristina, which was the absolute disaster of the visit. I found her service appalling, unpleasant, and lacking the professionalism and personal touch one expects from a pharmacy. An interaction like that not only makes you lose a customer, it makes that customer leave determined never to return.

I've been to many pharmacies over the years, and this is among the worst experiences I can remember.

The most surprising thing is that there are much better alternatives so close by. After comparing them, it's even harder to understand why anyone would choose this pharmacy.

I absolutely do not recommend it. For me, the experience was so bad that I don't plan on returning. A pharmacy should inspire trust and professionalism; this visit achieved exactly the opposite.

one_star_reviews.text:
Dismal experience at Cafe Pans.

The service was lacklustre, disinterested and painfully slow. The staff could barely muster a smile, and unfortunately the service from the female chef was even worse.

Despite ordering relatively simple food, we waited around 15 minutes for the first items — the onion rings and chicken strips — to arrive. The female chef had apparently forgotten our order of chips with bacon and cheese sauce altogether, so these arrived even later. When the chips eventually appeared, they were stone cold. By that stage, after such an extraordinarily long wait, we simply had no option but to eat them.

The onion rings were equally miserable. For around €5, three of the four rings we received were absolutely tiny (about an inch in diameter with no onion), with only one being a modest size. Just as we finished eating, we noticed another customer being served onion rings that looked completely different: four large, crispy rings, each several times the size of ours.

We raised this with the gentleman at the till, who spoke to the inept female chef. Their response, in essence, was that it was simply tough luck. No apology, no attempt to rectify it, and no interest..

Well done, guys. I hope you enjoy your jobs, because bringing any satisfaction to your customers certainly doesn’t appear to be part of them.

You may want to look at both the quality and consistency of the food you are serving, but above all at the attitude towards customers when something clearly isn’t right. Mistakes happen in any restaurant; what distinguishes good service is how staff respond when they do. On this occasion, the response was as depressing as the staff.

one_star_reviews.text: Disappointing. I had the injections in my head (hair mesotherapy), and €1000 was literally thrown in the trash... That's in my case, because the price seems to depend on how you look to them or your negotiating skills; they set different prices (which I didn't find professional at all). They showed me the photos, and in one of the three areas they showed me, the hair was even worse, while the other two were practically the same. They do treat you well, and you can have water and coffee, but obviously, it's not worth it. I did feel like I was being approached by someone from a utility company. I won't comment on the hair transplant since I didn't have one, so I can't give an opinion on that.

Unfortunately, I'm leaving another review after yet another failed attempt with this clinic.

During my initial contact, the conduct of the staff, both sales and medical, was inconsistent and unethical. Given the results of the first transplant and the behavior of one doctor in particular, I felt justified in posting a review here on Google and contacting a lawyer.

Some time later, a doctor at the clinic, more polite than the others up to that point, offered me another transplant, as the first one had been disastrous. I accepted and paid for the anesthesia. Once again, the same thing happened: before the transplant, I reiterated my usual warnings, and again, they ignored me.

Now, more than a year later, I'm speaking with the doctor again, and they tell me they'll perform another transplant for €1,000, since they didn't achieve an acceptable result. I'm not going to pay for gas anymore, not to be listened to and have my time wasted on nonsense.

I signed a contract thinking that this time they would listen to me, but again, they didn't. I've spoken with professionals at other clinics, and everything I ask for each time I go is actually achievable. They just need to listen to the client, put their egos aside, and stop trying to protect themselves with flimsy excuses.

My experience with Dr. Isabel González González was deeply unsatisfactory, and I feel it necessary to document the lack of respect and professionalism I experienced during my appointment.

During the consultation, I took out my cell phone with the sole purpose of showing her a medical test relevant to my evaluation. In response, the doctor reacted in a completely disproportionate manner, addressing me in offensive and inappropriate terms.

I believe that, regardless of the circumstances, every healthcare professional has a duty to maintain respectful, dignified treatment in accordance with the ethical principles that govern the practice of their profession. A disagreement or concern during a consultation can be expressed respectfully and professionally; insults and disparaging remarks toward a patient, however, are completely unacceptable.

I find it especially troubling that someone responsible for providing medical care would behave in this way toward a patient who was simply trying to provide relevant information for their own treatment.

I sincerely hope that these situations will be reviewed and that no other patient will have to experience similar treatment. For my part, my experience was enough to ensure that I will NEVER again seek care from this professional or recommend her.

one_star_reviews.text: Don't be fooled by the enticing storefront of this shop. It seems more like a tourist trap than a legitimate business. I bought a dress that was supposed to be delivered to France by mail. Initially, the communication was pleasant, and I even received a discount. So, I paid the full amount by bank transfer as agreed. However, the delivery was a disaster: no tracking whatsoever. No emails, no text messages; I had to check in via WhatsApp every week. Complete uncertainty, impossible to plan ahead. On the day of delivery, I received no notification. No call from the delivery driver, no message from him either, and don't even get me started on the shop. Nothing. The day I opened my mailbox, the package was there, ripped open, stolen. No recourse, weeks of silence, only to be told the matter was closed, that there was no insurance with the shipment (I wonder what I paid for!), and that the boutique didn't want to compensate me, not even a little, nothing. Worse, they offered me the option of buying "the" dress again with "a small discount." I've never seen anything like it, and I would never dare operate like that in my business. It's shameful and unworthy of a business. I hope you'll at least raise a glass to my health and make good use of my 100 euros!

one_star_reviews.text: Unfortunately, I had a very bad experience, and I admit I was partly to blame since we didn't have a lock on our storage unit because we trusted their claims of "security." We were robbed, but their insurance company ruled it wasn't a robbery because there was no sign of forced entry and no one was present. It's true we didn't have a lock on our unit, as they supposedly have individual silent alarms, but none went off when they broke in. The security cameras didn't see anything either. So, personally, I wouldn't recommend them because I don't believe the security they advertise is real.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with this psychologist has been profoundly negative. I believe her assessment was completely wrong and, even more worryingly, that during the process she presented certain behaviors as normal that were clearly harmful/pathological, both individually and within our relationship. Furthermore, I have been able to confirm with other psychologists that some of these normalizations were inappropriate and could severely and dangerously worsen the pathology/situation.

I expected to find a professional space that would help identify problematic dynamics, establish boundaries, and foster healthy progress. However, I had the opposite impression: certain behaviors were more than normalized, significant problems were minimized, and the interventions ended up exacerbating an already complicated situation.

In couples therapy, I consider it especially serious when certain dynamics are not properly assessed before being normalized or justified. In my case, the result was a considerable worsening of the situation and a very negative impact on both of us personally, as well as on our relationship. This lasted for months and has affected our mental health and our personal and professional lives.

I absolutely cannot recommend this service. My experience leads me to believe that a poorly planned psychological intervention can do far more harm than good, and that is precisely why I consider it important for others to evaluate this experience before entrusting themselves to this service.

Kurdish
As a Kurd, I came to Galicia to visit and see another oppressed people. But what I saw here was that they killed their own people and even put the Palestinian flag above their own. I, a Kurd, know that there are 22 Arab states besides Palestine. In the previous wars between Israel and Palestine, their Arab neighbors, such as Jordan and Egypt, understood the Palestinians (they saw that the Palestinians did not want peace) and gave them control and left.

The Kurds went to help Palestine 60 years ago. They took up their weapons and fought with them against Israel. But the Palestinians went to celebrate Saddam Hussein during the Kurdish genocide in Halabja and Anfal. They did not see the Kurds as a nation like their own. They made the case for Pan-Arabism. After that, many Kurds no longer saw themselves as Palestinians.

Let's look at the situation of the Kurds in the Galician context. There are also 40 million more Kurds. They have been colonized by 4 countries. But the Galician leftists did not see this. They still do not.

I saw this in my own Galician war.

And I saw that even their supposedly knowledgeable people do not know and do not know history as much as the Kurds. I know that before Galicia can remain leftist, their people will be assimilated and die.. ​

English
As a Kurd, I came to Galicia hoping to visit and connect with another oppressed nation. However, what I witnessed here was a political blindness—leftists who seem so consumed by their ideology that they even raise the Palestinian flag above their own. As a Kurd living next to the Arab world, I know very well that there are 21 other official Arab states besides Palestine. Historically, neighboring Arab states like Jordan and Egypt realized that the Palestinians were not seeking peace, eventually handing control back to them and stepping away.
​Sixty years ago, Kurds went to help Palestine. They took up arms and fought alongside them against Israel. Yet, during the Anfal campaign and the Halabja chemical massacre—when Kurds were being systematically exterminated—Palestinian leaders went and congratulated Saddam Hussein. They never viewed Kurds as an equal nation and chose to align with Pan-Arabism instead. After that betrayal, many Kurds stopped supporting the Palestinian cause.
Now consider the Kurdish reality: we are a stateless nation of over 40 million people, colonized and divided by four states. Yet the leftists in Galicia fail to see this, and they continue to ignore it.
My travels in Galicia made me realize that even their so-called intellectuals do not know or understand history as well as Kurds do. If Galicia remains trapped in this dogmatic leftist mindset, their own nation will inevitably face assimilation and disappear.

one_star_reviews.text: Making noise every morning, not letting people rest, sick people, do you think you're alone or what??, jumping, shouting…

BEWARE OF THIS PSYCHOLOGIST

From my unfortunate experience, I can assure you that this psychologist lacks the professional skills and aptitude to guide anyone through a delicate personal process.

It wasn't until I reached the hands of true professionals that I could repair all the damage this person caused.

He exacerbated my suffering and led me down the path of prejudice. He trivialized my feelings and emotions, which were legitimate, inherent, and naturally human. He showed very little understanding of the human dimension. He displayed scant consideration and little humanity.

I witnessed his ego firsthand, bewildered by what I was hearing and seeing. In the consultation, he spoke more about himself, his personal achievements, and his son than about the problem that had brought me there.

He minimized and invalidated my suffering, issued a completely erroneous diagnosis, and even ridiculed patterns of abuse I had experienced within my family, normalizing them. Issues that today have raised alarm bells in society were, for him, perfectly normal.

He even told me I was very beautiful and that my (abusive) family loved me very much. He made me buy three of his books, which only confused me more and more. What we would call cheap psychology today.

I won't go into further detail because I don't want to get into personal matters.

But I can assure you that it wasn't until I reached a multidisciplinary mental health team, guided by a psychiatrist, that I acquired the tools to understand and solve my problems.

There are professionals who have a natural talent, an innate ability to understand the human condition. Seek out people like that.

This psychologist, unfortunately, has no talent for this profession. Nor does he have any human touch. He seems blinded by vanity, the need for personal attention, his ambition, achievements, and professional prestige. He's greedy for his own ego.

If you're looking for a place to philosophize, have a coffee, and listen to the soundtracks (and the mindset) of Woody Allen, this is the place for you. And remember that having degrees doesn't make you a good professional.

I want to share my bad experience with this printing service for a very important event where we needed 27 custom t-shirts.
We had an image created by lA printed, and on the first print run, the person's face was completely distorted. The worst part is that the person in charge, instead of checking the first t-shirt and notifying us to change the design, printed all 27 defective ones without consulting us at all. When we received them at home, we realized the mistake and told him.
At that point, he told us he would replace them without any problem and at no additional cost, which we accepted. However, when he delivered the second print run (which was correct this time), he sent us an invoice overcharging us. When I showed him screenshots of our conversation where he stated there would be no cost, he became defensive.

To make matters worse, they justified their lack of professionalism by saying that they "didn't know the 27 shirts were for something important" and that "it wasn't their job to check if the first shirt was okay," simply printing them directly without any quality control. Their treatment of us and their complete lack of professionalism in the face of a mistake they themselves made were disappointing. We will not be using them again.

one_star_reviews.text:
Good afternoon, if you can call it that. I'm giving one star because there's no less. Where do we begin? On August 7th, my aunt was admitted to this care home after recent back surgery. We, the family, emphasized that her diaper had to be kept dry at all times to prevent infections, and we also requested that the bed have rails to prevent falls. We should start from the premise that when my aunt was admitted, she was completely bedridden. When we went to see her, we found: soiled diapers with feces lying on the floor, sheets stained with urine and feces where my aunt lay unchanged, and on those same soiled sheets, urine-soaked medications lying on the bed. Since my aunt couldn't move, and needed her diaper changed or anything else, she had to press the red button, like in hospitals. They never came, and it got to the point where they disconnected the button at night so she wouldn't call because, according to them, she was too much of a nuisance (I have a video that proves it; does anyone know how it could be posted here? I also have photos showing the medications lying on top of urine-soaked sheets; could the photos and video be uploaded here?). Of course, we family members were constantly asking to speak with the center's director, and you know what? She never showed up. I was seen by the center's commander, and my other family members by the social worker and one other person whose name I can't recall right now; but the director never came. I've been waiting for her to call me since last Wednesday. I could recount thousands of incidents, like an afternoon/evening assistant who told my aunt, "I'm not going to give you your sleeping medication tonight," or the scars she has under her armpit that we don't know how she got; and all this and more has happened in just 20 days.

The latest was eight days ago, on a Saturday, when we got a call at 2:00 PM informing us that my aunt had fallen at 5:00 AM and they found her face down, screaming for help. A nurse determined that she was fine. Hmmm, she falls at 5:00 AM and they don't notify us until 2:00 PM? They didn't call 112 (the emergency number) requesting an ambulance so she could be seen at the hospital, since she recently had back surgery, just because a nurse thought she was fine? Since when do nurses assess the severity of patients' conditions instead of doctors? That day, the family told them to call 112 requesting an ambulance so she could be seen at the hospital, and you know what? Eight days later, my aunt is still hospitalized, where today they had to operate on her back again to clean out all the pus inside. This was because at this nursing home, they wouldn't change her diaper, which was soaked with urine and full of feces.

I thank all the nurses, nursing assistants, doctors, social worker, and the director (who never bothered to speak to us). I thank all the professionals at this nursing home for having cared for my aunt so wonderfully. She is hospitalized today because of your impeccable care, and today she had to undergo back surgery again, and they will probably have to operate again because of your wonderful dedication to her, especially because of how clean you kept her. As of today, we don't know if she will ever stand up again or even be able to sit and eat on her own, thanks to these wonderful professionals.

If you want to completely ruin the life of a family member who needs specialized care, don't hesitate to take them to the BOUCO residence in Coslada.
Will they reply to my review? I imagine not, because they don't respond to bad reviews, only good ones; which I imagine were written by the residence staff themselves, because I've only seen one positive one.
Thank you so much to all the professionals at the BOUCO residence for completely ruining my aunt's life! Thank you from the bottom of my heart! We will never forget you.
Price assessment
Overpriced

I'd like to say that this residence is very good if you need a family member to stay in the hospital.
My sister came in after back surgery, and just a few weeks later (today, September 4th) she's back in the operating room and will possibly need to go back again. Thanks to the excellent hygiene and care she's received, among many other things, I'm very grateful.

Thank you.

Today, August 25th, in the afternoon, I went to CASAS in Ànec Blau looking for ergonomic shoes for my children, sizes 28 and 34. The service was terrible, and I received zero advice, despite asking for help and different sizes several times.

I finally chose a pair of Geox shoes (I'm familiar with the brand) for my little one. When I saw the price, I asked if it was discounted, as they were in a sale section. The answer was: it's not a new collection, and someone put it there.

Shortly after, I discovered that the same model was on sale for €35 on the CASAS website. Without hesitation, I went back to the store to return them and ask for a refund.

I had paid €65.20 (€65 for the shoes and €0.20 for the bag). They correctly refunded the price of the shoes, but instead of simply returning the bag, they threw it on the floor. I considered that completely unacceptable.

A regrettable experience from beginning to end. Lack of attention, transparency, advice, and ultimately, respect for the customer. I will not return to this store, nor do I recommend it.

I had a ticket for August 25th from Ibiza to Mallorca and arrived at the port with 25 minutes before departure. Staff refused to let me through security, citing I had to be there 1 hour prior to departure, which is not factual as online it says you have to be there 15 minutes prior if you’re traveling without a car. When I asked the employee handling boarding for their name, I was told they couldn’t provide it due to “company policy.”

I filed a formal complaint (hoja de reclamación) on-site. The lack of clear, accessible information about boarding cutoff times is a real problem, and the way staff handled the situation with no real explanation or accountability, made it worse. I will be  submitting this complaint to the consumer protection department, and I’d encourage anyone who has a similar experience to do the same.

Based on this, I won’t be using Balearia again and can’t recommend them.

My experience has been very disappointing. I went in for cosmetic restorations on four teeth and made it very clear that I wanted a natural result and for the color to match my teeth. I even asked to have just one done first to check the outcome.

In the end, they did all four. Two turned out acceptable, but two didn't, and one ended up with a clearly darker area that is very noticeable, especially in photos. I have before-treatment photos that clearly show my tooth didn't look like that.

When I complained about the result, I simply wanted them to review and fix the tooth that had turned out badly. However, instead of focusing on that problem, they scheduled me for other treatments on another molar. This was incomprehensible to me and increased my concern even more.

They also suggested restoring the entire tooth to achieve a uniform color. I believe that if a treatment doesn't turn out as requested, the first step should be to listen to the patient and find a solution to the problem, not steer the conversation toward other treatments.

But what disappointed me most was the lack of transparency regarding the costs. They even tried to charge me €90 for an X-ray that I had already had done through my insurance and given to the clinic. Finally, after explaining the situation, they told me I didn't have to pay for it. As I left, still in the X-ray, they told me I had to pay €50 for a treatment check-up. I was in shock right there... I was leaving with teeth I wasn't happy with because I couldn't even smile, and they were already thinking about what else they could extract...

After everything that happened, I have completely lost faith in this clinic. I wouldn't go back and I would never recommend it.

one_star_reviews.text:
I absolutely do not recommend this care home. Our experience has been horrific and has caused us enormous concern for the care of our elderly relatives.

Our family member left the care home after a significant decline, with dehydration, a weight loss of approximately 10 kg, and a substantial loss of muscle mass, to the point of being medically assessed as suffering from protein-energy malnutrition after being admitted to the hospital's emergency room.

The most worrying aspect is that the care home's own doctor didn't seem to be aware of the extent of her decline or the weight loss she had suffered. But the problem wasn't just the lack of communication with the family. We also discovered that she was being medicated with drugs that had a sedative effect, to the point of leaving her practically asleep or "half-drugged," without the family having been informed beforehand or receiving a clear explanation of the reason for this medication. In an elderly person with Alzheimer's, this seems especially serious to us, as they need to be able to eat, drink, communicate, and remain minimally active.

Furthermore, there is something as basic as hydration. A person with Alzheimer's may not ask for water or be able to express thirst, so it's impossible to rely on the resident to request a drink. However, in our experience, there was no adequate monitoring of fluid intake, with the consequences we subsequently witnessed.

During this period, there were also dehydration problems, infections, falls, and significant overall decline, requiring several medical evaluations.

Added to all this is something we find particularly concerning: the residence lacks adequate air conditioning, even in the common areas, which we consider completely unacceptable for elderly people, especially those who are vulnerable during the warmer months.

Our impression was one of zero control, zero monitoring, and utterly inadequate communication with the family.

A care home should not simply house our elderly relatives. There must be genuine monitoring of nutrition, hydration, weight, medication, drowsiness levels, falls, and changes in health status, along with clear communication with the family when anything changes.

Our experience has been disastrous, and we absolutely do not recommend this residence. Before entrusting the care of a family member there, we recommend that any family ask in detail how they monitor hydration, nutrition, weight loss, medication, alertness, infections, and the temperature conditions of the facilities.

I hadn't been there in a while, so I sat down at a table (I've always ordered and picked up to save them a trip), but I was with my crying baby, feeding him a bottle. I asked a waitress (a brunette) for a coffee, and she said no, I'd have to order at the bar. Okay, I completely understand that things have changed and they don't serve at tables anymore, but I don't think it would have been too much trouble for her to answer politely and order the coffee for me, even if I would have gone to get it myself.
I left, and unfortunately, I doubt I'll be back.
Group size
5-8 people

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with this residence has been very negative, and unfortunately, I cannot recommend it.

Although the facilities are good and have a lot of potential, I believe the management and care leave much to be desired. One of the main shortcomings I've noticed is the lack of an on-site doctor, which I find especially concerning in a residence for the elderly.

I've also been very dissatisfied with the lack of clarity regarding the resident fee. In my experience, we weren't provided with a sufficiently clear breakdown of the included charges, and I've noticed price changes that always resulted in an increase. I believe that a service of this nature should have much more transparency and explanation for families.

Furthermore, speaking with some residents, the impression I got wasn't good. On several occasions, when asked how they were doing, the answer was negative. I also observed situations and comments among direct care staff that conveyed a lack of coordination and an unprofessional atmosphere.

Regarding the management, my personal experience with those in charge was particularly disappointing. I feel that the treatment my relative received fell far short of what I expected from a facility of this kind. Furthermore, there were aspects related to their care and personal presentation that, from my perspective, left much to be desired.

It's a real shame, because the facilities themselves could make this a good center. However, in my experience, the problem lies with the management and certain aspects of the care provided. I believe there should be much more professionalism, transparency, oversight, and, above all, sensitivity towards the elderly and their families.

For all the reasons stated above, I absolutely do not recommend this residence. If you love your relative and are looking for a place where they can receive attentive, professional, and dignified care, my advice, based solely on my experience, is to consider other options before making the decision to place them here. After what I experienced, I would never choose this center again for a family member.
Price assessment
Overpriced

one_star_reviews.text:
Experience with a Vehicle Reservation
On June 25, 2026, we paid €1,000 as a deposit for a vehicle, agreeing that the necessary mechanical inspection and repairs would be carried out and that it would be delivered with a valid MOT/vehicle inspection certificate.
We were initially told that the vehicle would be ready in approximately one week. However, more than a month passed, and during all that time, we had to repeatedly contact the dealership ourselves to obtain information, without being given a specific delivery date.
On July 30, we finally went to pick it up and found that it was still leaking oil, the engine malfunction indicator light was on, and it still hadn't passed the MOT/vehicle inspection. Given this breach of contract, we decided not to proceed with the purchase and requested a refund of the €1,000.

During the following 20 days, we repeatedly requested the refund, receiving promises on several occasions that it would be returned, even with specific dates that ultimately were not met.

On August 18th, we returned to the dealership with an out-of-court request for a refund. When we asked for the official complaint form, we were told they couldn't provide it at that time. one_star_reviews.text:
I bought my car from CARPLUS and it's the worst decision I've ever made. This is my SECOND review and it's even worse than the first.

My initial experience was already a disaster: two weeks chasing them to be able to PAY for the second year's warranty (which I couldn't do because they ignored me), three different salespeople [Nacho, Ángel, and Alejandro] taking me to the manager, and still no solution, and a terrible delivery: scratched left headlight, stains on the upholstery, creaking in the automatic trunk, a rear USB port that doesn't work, constant noises on bumps and the highway, a missing cupholder cover, moisture inside the taillights, and most seriously, the ISOFIX anchor for the child seat was loose, compromising my son's safety. Zero pre-delivery inspection.

But it's only gotten worse since then: In FEBRUARY, the windshield washer fluid stopped working. A problem that predates this.

In June, I had a minor collision on the right side of the car, and when I took it in, they told me the wiper malfunction was due to the collision. That's a lie. It's been out of service for four months prior to the collision. They're trying to blame something completely unrelated to avoid covering it under warranty, washing their hands of the matter and telling me to take it to my insurance company, even though the car is still under warranty with them.

And to top it all off, now the parking lights in the left headlight have burned out. Since it's a BMW LED headlight, the entire unit needs to be replaced, and that should be covered under warranty. And Carplus's response? None. Not via WhatsApp, Gmail, or in person. Absolute silence.
It's a complete lack of professionalism, seriousness, and respect for the customer. They sell you the car and then forget all about it. You have to fight for every single thing, and even then, they lie to avoid taking responsibility.

If they don't give me an immediate solution, my next step will be to file a complaint and go to the Consumer Affairs Office (OMIC) with all the documentation, photos, and conversations.
I do NOT recommend CARPLUS to anyone. Don't buy here if you don't want to regret it every day. There are many dealerships in Seville that do take care of their customers.

one_star_reviews.text:
We went to this rental center yesterday evening to rent a 300cc Vespa scooter for one day, for the following day. The owner showed us the scooter we were supposed to receive, selected the “appropriate” helmets for us, completed the rental paperwork, and we paid the full amount as well as the deposit. We agreed that we would pick up the scooter the next day at 10:00 AM.

We arrived at the agreed time the following morning, but the owner was not there. Instead, one of his employees was handling the rental.

She started taking the scooters out, and when she reached the scooter that had been reserved for us, we told her that it was our scooter and that we had already paid for it. She immediately started shouting that this was not possible because that scooter had already been reserved for two other people. Those two people were outside waiting.

She took our rental agreement and the helmets that had already been placed on the scooter we had been promised and put them aside, again insisting in a very rude and disrespectful manner that the scooter was not ours.

She called her boss and told him that she would not give us the scooter that had been reserved for us and that we would have to wait. She continued speaking to us in a very unpleasant and hostile manner.

She then went to the back and found another 300cc scooter. From what we could see, this scooter appeared to be waiting for servicing: a service warning light was showing on the dashboard when it was started, it did not have a rear luggage box, and it looked noticeably older than the scooter we had been shown and promised the evening before.

We accepted this scooter anyway because we had no other choice. We already had reservations and plans for several destinations and could not afford to lose time.

What made the situation even worse was that we later noticed that she gave the original scooter to the two other people, even though their reservation had apparently only been made verbally. They had not completed any rental paperwork and had not made any payment for the scooter at that point, while we had already completed the paperwork and paid in full the previous evening.

There were also problems with the helmets. I was given a helmet without a visor, while my girlfriend was given a helmet that was too large. When we asked for a smaller one, we were simply told that there wasn’t one available.

On top of everything, the employee was extremely rude and disrespectful and, when we pointed out these issues, she spoke only German and did not communicate with us in English.

Despite everything that happened, neither she nor the owner, who was present when we returned the scooter, apologized for the situation or for the way we were treated.

Overall, we found this rental company extremely unprofessional and unreliable. We definitely do not recommend this rental center.

As for the Vespa itself, we were also disappointed with the scooter. On longer rides of around 50–60 km or more, it gets very hot, and the lack of a windshield creates a lot of discomfort when riding at around 70–80 km/h, even when there is no wind.

Based on our experience, we would not rent from this company again.

one_star_reviews.text:
I bought my car from them, and although I was already aware of the company's bad reputation and the problems several acquaintances had experienced after buying from them, they had the car I was looking for, so I decided to give them a chance.

At first, everything was fine. They provided me with the necessary paperwork and let me have a mechanical inspection done, although they were quite pressuring me to make the payment. Furthermore, the description in the ad didn't match the car's specifications, and despite asking several times, I couldn't find out about the extras until I had the vehicle in front of me.

The real problem started after I paid. The salesperson assigned to my car, Enrique, went on vacation and didn't leave anyone in charge of my order. More than a month has passed, which was the maximum agreed-upon timeframe, and I still don't have the car, nor do I know when it will arrive.

I had to call and write several times to get any answers, and I always received the runaround because no one knew anything about my car. I had bad experiences with the service I received, from Ana in administration, who even yelled at me on the phone, to Rafa, who hung up on me when I asked for explanations about the status of my vehicle.

Faced with this situation, I tried to contact Customer Service and was told that the only way to get in touch was via email at clientes@flexicar.es. They assured me I would receive a response within 24 hours. Two weeks have passed since I submitted a complaint to that email address, and I still haven't received a reply.

It was agreed in writing that the car needed repainting, reupholstering, and odor removal. When I finally picked it up, I requested the invoices, and the upholstery and odor removal were not listed, and indeed, they hadn't been done. The car still has a strong musty smell, the upholstery is blackened, the repainting in the agreed-upon area was poorly done, and it's full of pins and pet hair.

Furthermore, the vehicle was delivered to me with a cracked windshield, a door that won't open from the inside, and less than 30 km of range.

I picked it up a week ago and provided Enrique with written documentation detailing all these problems, but I haven't received a response.

A disappointing experience, from the condition of the vehicle to the lack of communication and customer service after I'd paid over €19,000.

They don't deliver on their promises. I will not recommend Flexicar to anyone, and certainly not the Badajoz dealership.

A complete fabrication. The car is broken, not just brake pads, a broken speaker, or unused wiper blades. The service is terrible. I called to complain, and they answered the first time, but then they stopped. They told me they would take care of it, but that was a lie. Now I'm on a trip from Seville to Burgos, and the clutch is broken. I called a roadside assistance service, and they only offer to pick it up 50 kilometers away. I have to go to the dealership in Badajoz in person. I asked for a complaint form, and they wouldn't give it to me because the guy there said he didn't know where they were. I'm very disappointed.

one_star_reviews.text:
If you're an adult, sensitive, and looking for answers, I don't recommend coming here. You'll encounter coldness, little empathy, and more questions than answers. A few weeks ago, I received the results of some tests I took. They charged me for the entire hour, but I was only seen for 10 minutes, without any detailed explanation of the results. For a psychologist, it's easy to read, but for someone who isn't a psychologist and suffers from anxiety, it's unpleasant. After spending a considerable amount of money, the least I deserved was a clear explanation and at least some empathy. I left the appointment devastated, not only because of the results but also because of Nuria's attitude. I waited a few weeks to feel better, to regain my strength, to reflect, and to see things more calmly before writing this honest review. Without doubting the professionalism of the staff at this place, I'm simply sharing my humble and unfortunate experience.

Update: The director called me to say that seeing me in 10 minutes is normal and that it was my fault for not answering my questions. This demonstrates once again the absolute lack of self-criticism and empathy of the center's management.

Update 2 months later.

I decided to go to therapy based on what Nuria told me. After 2 months in therapy with a wonderful psychologist (the complete opposite of what you'll find at this center), I finally discovered that yes, I am neurodivergent. And everything Nuria included in those results was ABSOLUTELY WORTHLESS. It would be advisable for her to review what she learned at university. She should be kinder, more empathetic, and above all, stop playing with people's money.

one_star_reviews.text:
I'm very sorry to say that I join those who have had a bad experience; in our case, a very bad one.

If your family member is dependent, don't bring them to this residence.

The reality is very different from how they portray it. If you visit your family member frequently, you'll realize it right away: you'll find them with their pants soaked in urine, you'll find out (too late) about calls to emergency services (061) that they don't inform you about, you'll see the elderly residents "parked" in their chairs all day. They promise walks and activities, but if you go often, you'll find that none of that is true, or it's far from being a regular practice.

The reason is clear: the staff is overwhelmed by the number of residents, and the dissatisfaction is palpable (I've even overheard arguments about salaries in the middle of the room with residents and their families). The staff shortage is obvious, and I'm not just referring to the anecdote of having to wait up to 20 minutes at the door to get in because no one answers (which is already a clue).

My relative was a healthy person who hadn't needed a doctor in years. In just three months, they've been hospitalized twice and required several calls to emergency services.

If your relative is dependent, be very careful with this residence; you need to be very attentive. I can't comment on the fully independent residents, as I understand their experience may be very different since they don't require as much care.

I understand this is a business like any other, but with the fees paid and the number of residents, I honestly believe the conditions could be much better.

one_star_reviews.text: Horrible. I share the frustration with this awful company that manages my retained savings. I sold my apartment on April 14th of this year, and as of today, August 20th, I have neither a breakdown, nor official documentation of the procedures carried out, nor the return of the remaining retained funds. You speak to various departments, and you hear them on speakerphone, laughing under their breath, telling the colleague that I was the one who called first. Basically, the delay is someone else's fault, not theirs, and that it could still take another two months. Excuse me? They've been reported to the Bank of Spain for lack of transparency. They were supposed to send us what we signed and the rest of the documentation by mail, and we haven't received anything. We have no breakdown, nothing. You call them, and not only do they not offer a solution, but you can tell they're laughing at you. Meanwhile, I have an open bank account that charges me €30 quarterly to keep it open, and I can't close it until I receive a refund. Are they going to cover these payments? Why shouldn't I have to pay them, since it's due to their processing delays and negligence?
